# Defend the Quantum Realm!

The Quantum Realm is under siege, and only you can defend it! Interdimensional beings are pouring through rifts in space and time, threatening to unravel the universe. As a Guardian, your mission is to protect the realm, gather resources, and rise to power.

### **Horde Survival Mode**
Play solo or team up with friends in **Horde Survival**, facing relentless onslaughts of enemies. Gather resources, level up, and unlock upgrades to stay ahead of the growing threat.

### **Custom Maps and PvP Battles**
Unleash your creativity by designing custom battle maps and challenging friends in intense **PvP battles**. Test your strategies and prove your dominance in dynamic, player-built arenas.

### **Loot and Gear Upgrades**
Defeated enemies drop loot to upgrade your gear and abilities. Build the ultimate loadout and become an unstoppable Guardian capable of taking on any challenge.

### **Immersive Mixed Reality**
Experience an engaging Mixed Reality adventure that brings the Quantum Realm to life. Battle enemies, explore custom maps, and enjoy thrilling action in your physical space.

The universe is your battleground—are you ready to take command?
